defect: the composition accepted databasePath ':memory:' and the qualifier still set verification VERIFIED with a durableBindingRef, so an in-memory store produced a durable-looking verified binding that cannot survive process termination

correction.qualificationDurability: src/execution_association/qualification.ts — QualifiedAssociation carries durability DURABLE | EPHEMERAL and the qualifier exposes the same value; makeAssociationQualifier defaults to DURABLE and the product composition passes EPHEMERAL when the derived path is ':memory:'
correction.consumerRule: a caller that REQUIRES cold-recoverable authority refuses an EPHEMERAL qualification; the value travels on the result rather than being inferred

evidence.observed: an in-memory store still yields verification VERIFIED (the H1 association is assembled from real evidence), and it now ALSO carries durability EPHEMERAL, so it cannot be presented as recoverable durable authority
evidence.note: the smallest coherent design consistent with the existing tests: the durable-binding reference is retained because it names the committed record, and the DURABILITY dimension is added beside it rather than removing the reference

expectedInvariant: an in-memory-only association must not masquerade as cold-recoverable durability
remainingUncertainty: durability describes the STORE substrate; a file-backed store on a volatile filesystem is DURABLE by this classification, which is the same local-provenance limit the source basis carries
